**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 17:15
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Type "nano filename" to open the "filename" file in the nano text editor.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Type "vi filename" to open the "filename" file in the vi text editor.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Type "emacs filename" to open the "filename" file in the emacs text editor.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In nano, press "Ctrl + O" to save the changes made to the file and "Ctrl + X" to exit the editor.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In vi, press "Esc" to enter command mode, type ":w" to save the changes made to the file, and ":q" to exit the editor. To save and exit the editor in one step, type ":wq".
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In emacs, press "Ctrl + X" followed by "Ctrl + S" to save the changes made to the file and "Ctrl + X" followed by "Ctrl + C" to exit the editor.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In nano, press "Ctrl + G" to display the help menu and the available keyboard shortcuts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In vi, press "Esc" to enter command mode, type ":help" to display the help menu, and ":q" to exit the help menu.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In emacs, press "Ctrl + H" followed by "Ctrl + T" to display the tutorial and "Ctrl + X" followed by "Ctrl + H" to display the help menu.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In nano, press "Alt + Shift + U" to undo the last action and "Alt + Shift + E" to redo the last action.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In vi, press "Esc" to enter command mode, type "u" to undo the last action and "Ctrl + R" to redo the last action.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In emacs, press "Ctrl + \_" to undo the last action and "Ctrl + G" followed by "Ctrl + \_" to redo the last action.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In nano, press "Ctrl + K" to cut the selected text, "Ctrl + U" to paste the cut text, and "Ctrl + W" to search for a specific text string.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In vi, press "Esc" to enter command mode, type "dd" to cut the current line, "p" to paste the cut text, and "/" followed by the text string to search
